history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration issue guidance to entities to increase their focus on improving equitable geographical representation.
history.administration_response: The Administration wishes to note that the guidance is provided in the Geographical Diversity Strategy. Entities can access information on geographical representation through the management dashboard for monitoring purposes. In addition, the Office of Human Resources has developed and provided the entities with a diversity toolkit on recruitment and reassignment, which provides detailed guidance and checklists for each stage of the recruitment process so as to improve equitable geographical representation. As part of the Geographical Diversity Strategy, the Under-Secretary- General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance meets with each head of entity to highlight the importance of the equitable geographical representation and gender parity human resources imperatives and to discuss(a) the entity’s action plan; (b) possible scenarios and outcomes, and (c) the way forward and next steps for accelerating progress. The Administration requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the key performance indicator on geographical representation has not been achieved for two consecutive years, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration issue guidance to entities to increase their focus on improving equitable geographical representation.
history.administration_response: The Office of Human Resources has provided detailed guidance to entities on how to improve geographical representation: in 2023, the Office of Human Resources organized two sessions (October and December) with peacekeeping operations and special political missions to provide relevant information on equitable geographical distribution targets in order to further enrich their understanding and explore the opportunities for collaboration on talent outreach and desirable changes to the system. Focal points were established to share information on progress for entities whose representation status is shared monthly. In January 2024, at the Management Committee meeting on the importance of equitable geographical distribution and its progress, the Office of Human Resources gave a presentation to the heads of entities on changes to the system of desirable ranges in accordance with General Assembly resolution 77/278 and their impact on equitable geographical distribution, and a new approach to improving equitable geographical distribution. In February 2024, the Office of Human Resources once again gave a presentation to the heads of entities through the Management Client Board, underlining their pivotal role in accelerating progress towards equitable geographical distribution and prioritizing the attainment of the targets. In April 2024, in view of resolution 77/278, the Assistant Secretary-General of the Office of Human Resources will be sending a communication to heads of entities emphasizing the urgency to bringing every Member State within its desirable range. In addition to the above, the Office of Human Resources continues to provide guidance to entities in the monthly communication on equitable geographical distribution, and we therefore consider the recommendation to be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Office of Human Resources has provided detailed guidance to entities on how to improve geographical representation, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
